label: There is no per se causal loop: no…, from A middle cause efficiently causes that of… and 3 more
meaning: The Second Way's 'sic esset prius seipso', extended from self-causation to finite loops of per se causes. Refutes STMT-PER-SE-CAUSAL-LOOP given its open premises. Its refutes relation REL-PER-SE-CAUSAL-LOOP-IMPOSSIBLE-REFUTES does not count until its premises are established (#391, #999). The transitivity premise STMT-SIMPLE-PRIORITY-IS-TRANSITIVE is also not yet sourced. It does not refute STMT-INFINITE-PER-SE-CAUSE-SERIES, so STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-SERIES stays open. The Comparator config also verifies needsTransitivity, needsNothingPriorToItself, needsCausePriorToEffect and needsMiddleCause: each premise is needed.
